_doc: Curtain product catalog — track, fittings (end brackets, ceiling/wall brackets, gliders), and fabric. Hand-edited. Generators consume this and emit specs/_partials/curtain-quantity-<scope-id>.md.
_pricing_rule: Per-metre products (track, fabric) use baht_per_metre_min + _max. Per-unit fittings use baht_per_unit_min + _max. All prices are RANGES (placeholder until shopping confirmed).
_per_calc_rule:
Each fitting declares how its qty is computed per window:
  - 'per-window'              → 1 per window (× window qty)
  - 'per-track-metre'         → ceil(track_m_per_window × 100 / interval_cm) per window
  - 'per-curtain-width-metre' → ceil(fabric_m_per_window × 100 / covers_cm_per_unit) per window
The generator reads per_calc + the optional interval_cm / covers_cm_per_unit fields.
_sizing_assumption: Drop fits within the fabric bolt width (typical 280 cm bolt handles up to ~250 cm drop with hem/heading allowance). For taller windows that exceed the bolt, the math under-counts and the spec needs a hand-edit note. Verify in store.

ikea-vidga-track.name: IKEA VIDGA single-track curtain rail (140 cm, connectable/cuttable)
ikea-vidga-track.notes: Cuttable aluminium rail. Standard length is 140 cm. Price adjusted to reflect per-metre average of the 140cm unit.

ikea-vidga-end-bracket.name: IKEA VIDGA end-bracket/cap pair
ikea-vidga-end-bracket.notes: End caps finish the track ends. Note: The main VIDGA track usually includes standard end caps, but corner pieces or specific end returns are sold separately.

ikea-vidga-mount-bracket.name: IKEA VIDGA ceiling bracket (every 80 cm of track)
ikea-vidga-mount-bracket.notes: One bracket per ~80 cm of track. Swap SKU to 504.928.11 if wall-mounting (12 cm projection) is required.

ikea-vidga-glider-pack.name: IKEA VIDGA glider and hook pack (24 pack)
ikea-vidga-glider-pack.notes: Pack of 24 glider hooks. One pack covers ~2.4 m of finished curtain width (assuming 1 hook every 10cm).

ikea-fabric-280cm-white.name: IKEA DITTE / MINNA / AINA — white fabric by the metre
ikea-fabric-280cm-white.notes: Corrected: IKEA fabrics by the metre (like DITTE) are typically 140-150 cm wide, NOT 280 cm. If 280 cm width is required, look toward standard textile markets (e.g., Pahurat) or specific HomePro blackout rolls. SANELA and RITVA are sold as pre-made panels, not raw bolts.

homepro-rod-generic.name: HomePro generic curtain rod (with finials)
homepro-rod-generic.notes: Adjusted price to reflect standard telescopic or custom-cut metal rods. Confirm exact rod + finial SKU at HomePro. Used by scopes with style=eyelet-on-rod.

homepro-rod-bracket-generic.name: HomePro curtain-rod bracket pair (one set per window)
homepro-rod-bracket-generic.notes: One pair of mount brackets per window for the curtain rod. Center bracket added for runs > 200 cm (standard sag threshold).

homepro-panel-eyelet-generic.name: HomePro generic eyelet curtain panel (140 cm wide, 250 cm drop)
homepro-panel-eyelet-generic.notes: Pre-made eyelet panel. HomePro standard panels are often 130-140 cm wide. Drop is up to 250 cm. Calc: panels_per_window = ceil(window_width × fullness / panel_width).
